how: Two parts. Part A: given the brand character below, derive the test; the derived question must name the same trait (wording may differ). Part B: apply the stated test to each line; compare pass/fail. Record the run in runs.md.

part_a_derive.character: The Quiet Refuser: restraint, presence, considered confidence. Refuses the hospitality default of effusive welcome. Vocabulary: plain, quiet, real.

part_b_apply.test: Is this effusive? (markers: exclamation marks, self-praise of the venue, performed warmth)

lines.line: Welcome to our wonderful restaurant! We're so excited to have you here this evening!!
Lamb shoulder, slow-cooked, served with the broth.
Our master chef's signature lamb, lovingly hand-prepared over twelve hours.
Tomorrow's lamb is delayed by a day. We'll run the duck through Friday lunch.
Hi team, sorry to bother you but unfortunately we have a small issue with the lamb tomorrow!!
That's not yours — I'll fix it.
Oh my goodness I am SO sorry, let me make this right for you right away, anything you need!

scope_check.expected: out of scope: a tagline is judged by the brand book, not the filter test; the skill must say so rather than fail it
